versions.subject: rule: sharpup
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\SharpUp.exe'
selection_pe:
    Description: 'SharpUp'
selection_commandline:
    CommandLine|contains: 
        - 'HijackablePaths'
        - 'UnquotedServicePath'
        - 'ProcessDLLHijack'
        - 'ModifiableServiceBinaries'
        - 'ModifiableScheduledTask'
        - 'DomainGPPPassword'
condition: 1 of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\SharpUp.exe" OR Description="SharpUp" OR CommandLine IN ("*HijackablePaths*", "*UnquotedServicePath*", "*ProcessDLLHijack*", "*ModifiableServiceBinaries*", "*ModifiableScheduledTask*", "*DomainGPPPassword*")
